basic_info.description: NEWLY BUILT! Designed by famed architect Robert Rudeen. This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium is right in the heart of the sunny side of San Francisco's infamous North Beach. This unit is rear facing which is perfect for someone who is looking to have more privacy with lots of natural lighting, large open floorplan that feels bigger than it is, in addition to the bedrooms being on opposite sides of each other! This unit comes with stackable washer dryer hook ups, all Thermador appliances, heated flooring in all full bathrooms, heated toilet with bidet in Master, 9-foot ceilings, and a 60 square foot balcony. This beautiful building has all the luxury amenities one could desire including a state of the art workout gym and an oversized shared resident rooftop deck with 2 stainless steal gas grills, 3 fire pits and ample outdoor seating! Come take a look!
